notes: SITE IDENTITY (Rule 3): aerin.com is AERIN's own Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce storefront and it is a fully shoppable catalogue (1,622 products indexed), not a lookbook. It carries BOTH the Estee Lauder AERIN beauty line and the AERIN lifestyle/home business on one domain. The roster URL https://www.aerin.com/home-decor is not a real path; the home decor tree is /home/ -> /home/decor/ and /home/tabletop-bar/, plus a separate top-level /lighting/. ACCESS: every direct route was HTTP 403 from PerimeterX behind Fastly - all 11 curl_cffi impersonation profiles (desktop and mobile), Googlebot / Bingbot / Screaming Frog UAs, translate.goog, WebFetch, /graphql, /rest/V1 and the sitemap; r.jina.ai was itself Cloudflare-challenged for this workstation across 12 retries; microlink's headless renderer was blocked too. Only /robots.txt was allowlisted. Two routes worked: (1) the api.allorigins.win server-side fetch proxy, which returned the genuine 281 KB category HTML and with it the full snowdogMenu mega-menu (every category URL below is taken verbatim from that nav) plus the Klevu config; (2) the storefront's own Klevu search layer on uscs32v2.ksearchnet.com, which is not behind PerimeterX. COUNTS: the category pages render their grid and their #toolbar-amount header client-side from Klevu, so the Klevu CATNAV totalResultsFound for a categoryPath IS the number the site reports. Every count was verified empirically (Rule 1): enumerated to exhaustion at 100 per page, unique product-id count equals the reported total, records still returned at offset=total-1 and zero at offset=total, on all 20 categories tested. Cross-checked against an independent full-catalogue dump (1,622 records / 1,622 unique ids): CATNAV matched the denormalised klevu_category tally exactly on 19 of 20 leaves and on every parent node (Home 687, Home;Decor 388, Home;Tabletop & Bar 328, Lighting 764, Ceiling Lights 360, Lamps 185, Wall Lights 207). Only Barware diverged (82 live vs 94 stale) and the live CATNAV figure was used. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: all Beauty (fragrance, scent, skincare, brushes, makeup bags), Fashion, Gifts, The Edit, Collaborations, New Arrivals, Sale, Bestsellers, Heirloom Collection, Personalize, Antique & Vintage, Living with Flowers, and the Lighting > Style / Collection filter pages. Also dropped, with reasons read off actual product titles: Home > Decor > Candles & Diffusers (23, with children Candles 15 and Classic Candles 5) - titles are scented candles and reed diffuser sets, i.e. home fragrance, with only one unscented taper SKU; Floral Arrangements (34) - AERIN x Diane James faux florals; Objects & Books (13) - 8 of 13 are porcelain or gilded artificial flowers and 3 are books; Games (32), Office Accessories (34) and Stationery (4) - not decor; Bathroom Accessories (26) and Lighting > Wall Lights > Bathroom Lights (34) - bathroom; Throw Blankets (5) and Tabletop > Table Linens & Placemats (87, children Napkins 40 / Placemats 27) - textiles; Tabletop > Flatware (10) - cutlery; Home > Furniture & Mirrors (26) - 23 of 26 are consoles, coffee and side tables, vanity sets, wastebaskets, magazine racks and an umbrella stand with only 3 mirrors and no mirrors-only child, so the mixed roll-up was dropped rather than padded. SUBSET CHECK: pairwise product-id intersections were computed over all emitted leaves - none is a subset of another. Largest overlaps are genuine cross-listings (Barware ^ Serveware & Trays 38, Barware ^ Drinkware 15, Drinkware ^ Serveware & Trays 6). The Klevu index also exposes a Candle Accessories > Candle Holders node (32, entirely inside Candle Accessories 49) but it does not appear in the site nav, so Candle Accessories is emitted as a single leaf. Barware is kept as a leaf because the bulk of its 82 items are glassware, decanters, pitchers, ice buckets, footed bowls, trays and coasters; roughly 6 bar tools remain inside it. RULE 0 TOP-UP ADDENDUM (2026-08-10): re-read this file's own notes above, which had already logged the two room-word exclusions from before Rule 0 existed - 'Bathroom Accessories (26)' and 'Lighting > Wall Lights > Bathroom Lights (34)' were dropped purely for the word 'Bathroom'. Re-verified access (still only api.allorigins.win works; PerimeterX/Fastly 403s every direct fetch, curl_cffi profile, translate.goog and WebFetch attempt) and re-pulled the full snowdogMenu mega-menu plus the Klevu CATNAV counts for both nodes using the same methodology as the rest of this file (uscs32v2.ksearchnet.com/cs/v2/search, apiKey klevu-168114169562516258, categoryPath now confirmed to live at settings.query.categoryPath per js.klevu.com/theme/default/v2/catnav-theme.js). Added 'Bathroom Lights' (34, all wall sconces/vanity lights, pure lighting product type, Rule 0.1/0.4) as a leaf under Lighting > Wall Lights. Added 'Bathroom Accessories' (26 total records) with a product-type filter per the brief: 3 are mirrors (added separately as 'Bathroom Mirrors', Rule 0.3 - same 3 ids also cross-list into the already-excluded Home;Furniture & Mirrors node, confirming genuine cross-listing) and 12 are genuinely decorative objects (tumbler, tissue box covers, vide poche, trays - added as 'Bathroom Accessories'); the other 11 (canister, wastebaskets, soap dispensers, soap dish) are storage/utility products and were left out per Rule 0.4 and the base storage-exclusion rule, matching how this file already treats wastebaskets in the dropped Furniture & Mirrors node. Full mega-menu re-check confirmed no other room-based lighting or mirror branch exists: Wall Lights has only Wall Lamps/Wall Sconces/Bathroom Lights as children, there is no Vanity/Outdoor/Recessed/Track/Landscape/Kitchen-island lighting node anywhere on the site, and Furniture & Mirrors remains the only other node touching mirrors (still correctly excluded, furniture-majority). No other rows were touched.
